title: OpenAM before 16.1.4 contains an open redirect and cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows remote attackers to…
description: OpenAM versions prior to 16.1.4 have an open redirect and cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability. This flaw allows remote attackers to manipulate post-login and logout redirect destinations via the 'goto' and 'gotoOnFail' parameters. Exploitation can lead to redirecting users to phishing sites or executing malicious scripts in the XUI interface to steal session cookies.
